coverage: bounded undo/redo history on Vst3TimelineEditorV1 with fixed 8-entry stacks and oldest-eviction when full
successful commit pushes the pre-commit published state and clears the redo stack
undo restores the exact prior published snapshot; redo re-applies it
a new commit after an undo clears the redo stack (branching history)
undo/redo refuse while an edit session is active and leave the draft untouched
discard leaves history intact; reset clears both stacks
capacity verified with twelve sequential commits: depth capped at eight, eight undos drain to the deterministic mid-state
C++ build and CTest contract suite (1/1 passed)
schema v2 ownership, scope exclusivity and Git ancestry checks
documentation gates with refreshed BASELINE counters, source-only policy and whitespace cleanliness

limitations: History is per-editor-instance in memory only; persistence across process restarts is out of scope.
Scheduler-bound sessions refuse undo/redo by design because the wrapped editor has an active draft.
User-space source-contract evidence only; this proves nothing about physical audio, per-App delivery, drivers, HLK or Microsoft signing.
